title: Shape Evolver
role: Explore how small inherited changes and repeated selection can reshape evolving forms.
description: An interactive biomorph-style tool for exploring variation, inheritance, constraint, and visible change over time.

implementation.notes: The Shape Evolver public route now uses the newer Biomorph implementation as its current interactive engine.

api.notes: A shared browser and node-consumable API module now exists for the artificial-life remediation family.

tests.notes: A node-based contract test suite now exercises the shared artificial-life family API module.

provenance.summary: Public evo-edu framing over the current Biomorph implementation.
provenance.details: Shape Evolver is the evo-edu public route for biomorph-style artificial selection. It now launches the newer Biomorph implementation, which adds a parent plus 3x3 litter workflow, mutation legends, save/import/export support, automated fitness evaluators, development animation, and curriculum support pages.
limits: The runtime is a pedagogical browser model, not a biological-development simulator.
The displayed forms are generated phenotypes controlled by simplified integer genes.
